decisions.reason: As a flagship transactional email service built on the firm's core messaging infrastructure, it costs little to carry and still has growth potential in cloud adoption, so the option remains valuable.
Customer adoption evidence shows the option is resolving favorably, and the service fits the firm's electronic document workflow direction at low marginal cost.
The conversion service runs on existing fax and email platforms, so it is cheap to keep, and it serves regulated customers who still depend on fax.
The feature sits close to the established fax business and costs almost nothing to maintain, though declining fax demand gives it limited upside.

Sandbox threat protection is a growing security need that complements the core email security offer, so its option value outweighs its low carrying cost, especially after the multi-engine scanner was already dropped.
